Rusty? The switching cheat-sheet

The four things everyone forgets after time away.

Cockpit MODE switch dflt: M

Flips COMBAT (weapons) ⇄ ANALYSIS (scanners/DSS). Same trigger fires guns or probes depending which you're in. Guns won't fire? Wrong mode.on your stick — Joy_2 (a grip button)

The 4 UI panels

Focus a panel, steer with UI ◂▸▴▾ + Select/Back.LEFT Navigation · RIGHT Systems/fire-groups/cargo · TOP Comms · BOTTOM Role

Fire groups

Map primary+secondary triggers to different tool sets (guns / mining / scanners). Cycle next-previous to swap mid-flight.Joy_46 / Joy_47 on your throttle box

Pips — power 4-way

Six across SYS/ENG/WEP. Up ENG, left SYS, right WEP, down reset 2/2/2. Hauling? Lean ENG.your stick trim hat H2 (Joy_9–12) — confirmed

Elite control reference

Plain-English rundown of the functions worth having on the rig.

Flight
Throttle · 75% · Full stopSpeed axis. 75% sits in the blue best-turn zone.
Pitch · Roll · Yaw · ThrustStick pitch/roll, yaw on twist; strafe for docking + jousting.
Boost · Flight AssistBoost dumps ENG; FA-off = Newtonian drift.
Targeting & weapons
Select ahead · cycle · hostile · highest threatLock what's ahead; cycle contacts; jump to threats.
Primary/Secondary fire · Cycle fire groupTwo triggers of the active group; cycle to swap loadouts.
Deploy hardpointsRun the guns; flips to Combat HUD.
Power, modes & utilities
Pips SYS/ENG/WEP · Reset4-way power hat; reset 2/2/2.
Mode switch · Heat sink · Chaff · ECM · Shield cellCombat⇄Analysis + utility slots (B1 Heat Sink, B2 ECM).
Gear · Scoop · Lights · Night visionThe "modes" toggles — the throttle switch bank.
Navigation, FSD & scanners
FSD · Jump next in route · SC AssistSupercruise/hyperspace; auto-throttle to a drop.
Discovery Scan (honk) · DSS probesAnalysis mode: honk the system, fire probes to map bodies.
